_doc: Bosch Rexroth strut profile 30x60: 60 x 30 mm with the 8 mm slot, anodised. Dimensions and section figures are from the MGE 14.0 catalogue, which prints them to 0.1 cm² and 0.1 cm⁴: on a section this small that is a step of several percent. It is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (the catalogue's Iy). The drawn outline leaves out the four notches round each bore, the V marks on the core and the rounded corners of the hollows.
